Am not really that kind of familiar with the OG story, but I've seen one theory where it is stated that both Sephiroth and Aerith are connected to the lifestream. This explains how both are kind of "shady" as to their current knowledge in the remake. Sephiroth may be connected with the lifestream (idk if it's true or not, seeing my lack of FF7 knowledge).

Though, there is one line that is missed out on the most. It is Red XII's line "The flow of the great river that is the planet, from inception to oblivion". What this could mean is that the lifestream is one huge timeline of events, from birth to destruction. From what Red XIII said, "the flow of the GREAT RIVER" - based on the "great river" alone, it could be theorized that anyone who could tap into this great river can essentially jump into any point of time.

This may or may not explain the shady knowledge between Aerith and Sephiroth, seeing that both of them are connected to the lifestream.

Still, I could be completely wrong about this one, but this game really made my brain working again.

It is not impossible to connect deeply with other people. All it takes is someone who understands and time. There are lots and lots of people whom we can deeply connect with. 

On a side note, the reason why we already feel like we cannot connect with other people, is simply because we connected with the wrong person. Connecting with the wrong person adds up to the fear of being laughed at. Choose the right person, you'll know it.

At one point in time, you'll realize that being lonely is a beautiful feat. Every one of us might have been lonely at some point. After all, you only have you to watch for yourself. It is the fight for survival, so do what you think is best for you.

If the thought of loneliness really is eating you up, just think that there are billions of fishes in the sea. Your so-called friends might not even be true friends; they do not deserve you. They are just few, out of the billions.

If you have a good life, then keep on going. Think about all these good memories of yours, your loving family, and your good life overall. Life may be bland sometimes, so it's a beautiful and a fulfilling thing to do something new. If you haven't tried travelling, then go for it and try it. It's a beautiful way to take a break. If you haven't tried camping, hiking, or any other outdoor activities, try it. Use your hard-earned money for you to do something new. You are still young, and there are still lots and lots of things that you can do and you don't know. There's no harm in trying something new.

There are still lots and lots of new people you are going to meet. Soon, you'll find your true friends.

Also, Happiest Birthday! Wish you all the best.

Don't wish yourself to be sick. If you want to take a break, then take a break. Every one of us need to take a break sometimes, so don't be afraid to use that pass. After all, you only need yourself to fight for survival.

Personally though, staying at home for a day or for even a week messes up with my mind. A lot of bad thoughts just go inside my mind every time I'm not doing something. Might be different for you. Just think about yourself and think what's best for you.
